_readme: SYNTHETIC — hand-built, NOT captured from NOAA. Every other tide-*.json in
this directory is a verbatim recording of a real CO-OPS response; this file
is the opposite and is named so nobody confuses the two.
These are the corruptions a real response could plausibly arrive with and
that CO-OPS did not hand us on the day we captured. Each one exists to prove
src/lib/tide.ts REFUSES rather than substituting a number.
nullHeight is the load-bearing one. Number(null) === 0, and 0.0 ft at MLLW is
an ordinary, believable tide, so a `?? 0` here fabricates a reading that no
reviewer would ever spot on screen. This project has already invented 1,095
high-severity weather events from that exact bug.

nullHeight.why: v is JSON null. Number(null) === 0 — the fabrication case.

emptyStringHeight.why: v is "". Number("") === 0 — same fabrication, different shape.

missingHeightKey.why: v absent entirely. Number(undefined) is NaN, but a ?? would reach 0.

numericZeroHeight.why: v is a real string "0.000". This one is VALID and must be accepted — 0.0 ft at MLLW is a genuine reading, which is exactly why the null case is invisible.

nonNumericHeight.why: v is text. Number("n/a") is NaN.

badTimestamp.why: t is not a CO-OPS timestamp.

impossibleDate.why: Date.UTC(2026, 1, 31) silently rolls over into March.

missingType.why: hi/lo row with no H/L marker.

outOfOrder.why: predictions descend. The pure readers binary-search and assume ascent.
